name: ADX/DMI trend: ADX slope up, ADX>23, DI direction, MA and volume filters
author: Pine community script
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
indicators: ADX(14), DI(14), ATR support, SAR support
entry_long: ADX(14,14) greater than its value 3 bars ago, ADX > 23, +DI > -DI, close >= MA filter, volume above filter (multiplier of average or manual).
entry_short: ADX rising, ADX>23, -DI > +DI, close <= MA filter, volume filter, shorts enabled.
exit: Exit when ADX slope turns down (adx - adx[1] < 0) or ATR / SAR support hit.
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: MA filter, volume filter, date window
implementation_notes: ATR/SAR support exit parameters are separate inputs (see script); marked complete for the core signal only.
